card.name: Hyphens in phone numbers and compounds
card.fires_on: The hyphen inside a toll-free phone number after a company contact line, and the hyphen in 'non-insulin-dependent'. Also a few partway-through-name spots such as Kale|tra and Pro|zac.

modes.label: Phone number hyphen
modes.description: The hyphen after the 1-888 or 1-866 area part of a reporting phone number.
modes.example: should be reported to Fondazione Telethon ETS at 1-888<<->>212-6928

modes.label: Hyphen in non-insulin-dependent
modes.description: The hyphenated word dependent in the term non-insulin-dependent diabetes.
modes.example: in patients with non-insulin<<-dependent>> diabetes. The study involved 82

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: The ending piece of a brand name in parentheses after a drug name.
modes.example: Lopinavir/ Ritonavir (Kale<<tra>>) Patients with renal or hepatic impairment
